# Background Image

#### Course: Learn CSS

## Background Image

You use the background-image property to add a background image to HTML elements.

For this example, we have an image named bg.png in our system, located within the folder structure: images > learn-css. You can access it at /images/learn-css/bg.png.

![CSS Background Image](data:image/png;base64,)

Let's learn how to use it as a background.
